answer: Fake agents drift in like a nebula until standing has to be gilded by hand. A newcomer earns it by burnishing 20 gold-leaf frames over 26 days, with each frame's 50 leaves counted and burnish-tested by two gilders from different workshops and logged on the gilding board. One frame shedding more than 3 leaves voids its credit and pauses gilding 14 days; 3 shedding frames void the tally. Faking 1,000 agents takes 20,000 frames, 1,000,000 leaves and 40,000 inspections, while one honest agent gilds a single frame at a time. Trust grows like a lotus on a mesa lake, rooted in still water.
